us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic headlines from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: US marks 25 years since the September 11 attacks
bullets: Memorial ceremonies are being held in New York, at the Pentagon and in Shanksville, Pennsylvania.
The anniversary honors nearly 3,000 people killed in the 2001 al-Qaida attacks.
Events include moments of silence, name readings, wreath-laying and volunteer service projects.

articles.title: US inflation picked up as gasoline prices jumped
bullets: The latest inflation report showed prices accelerated in August.
AP reported higher gas prices tied to renewed Middle East fighting were a major factor.
The report intensified affordability concerns ahead of the November midterm elections.

articles.title: Appeals court keeps block on Trump mail-voting order
bullets: A federal appeals court upheld a preliminary injunction against the executive order.
The case is also before the Supreme Court as states begin sending midterm ballots.
Election officials warned the order’s requirements would be impossible to meet on current timelines.

articles.title: Appeals court rejects Trump administration’s mandatory immigration detention policy
bullets: The 4th Circuit ruled the policy of holding immigrants without bond hearings is illegal.
The ruling deepens a split among federal appeals courts.
The split increases the chances the Supreme Court will review the issue.

articles.title: Trump’s proposed $5,000 checks draw pushback from Congress and economists
bullets: Trump proposed sending $5,000 to American adults if Republicans keep Congress.
AP reported the plan would likely cost more than $1 trillion.
Lawmakers and economists questioned the proposal’s legality, cost and inflation risk.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major international developments from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Poland warns Russia may intensify provocations near Ukraine’s European borders
bullets: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk cited recent incidents near Ukraine’s borders with Poland and Moldova.
Two people died when Russian drones hit a Ukraine-Moldova crossing, according to AP’s report.
Tusk said Poland was assessing regional risks after a CIA briefing.

articles.title: UK defense chief says more than 500,000 Russian troops killed in Ukraine
bullets: A senior British defense official put Russian military deaths above 500,000 since February 2022.
The same official estimated total Russian casualties at about 1.5 million.
Russia did not immediately comment on the figures.

articles.title: BRICS leaders gather in New Delhi amid wars and rivalries
bullets: India is hosting the BRICS summit in New Delhi this weekend.
Putin, Xi Jinping and Iran’s Masoud Pezeshkian are among expected leaders.
The expanded bloc faces divisions over Ukraine, the Middle East and US-China tensions.

articles.title: US says progress made reopening Strait of Hormuz, but Iran war drags on
bullets: AP reported the US has loosened Iran’s grip on the Strait of Hormuz in recent weeks.
The war launched by the US and Israel in February remains unresolved.
Higher oil and diesel prices are adding pressure to global inflation.

articles.title: Hong Kong Tiananmen vigil organizers sentenced in national security case
bullets: Three prominent activists received prison sentences of about five to seven years.
They were convicted of inciting subversion under Hong Kong’s national security law.
The case is widely viewed as a marker of shrinking political freedoms in the city.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India headlines from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: PM Modi and Vladimir Putin hold pre-BRICS bilateral meeting in Delhi
bullets: Modi and Putin met in Delhi on Friday ahead of the BRICS summit.
The talks were expected to focus on trade, energy and defense.
The Indian Express reported civil nuclear cooperation and critical minerals were also likely topics.

articles.title: Putin arrives in New Delhi for BRICS summit and bilateral meetings
bullets: Russian President Vladimir Putin arrived in New Delhi ahead of the 18th BRICS Summit.
He is scheduled for talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi and other bilateral meetings.
Security was stepped up around diplomatic hotels and summit venues.

articles.title: Xi Jinping’s India visit for BRICS confirmed
bullets: China confirmed Xi Jinping will attend the New Delhi BRICS summit on September 12–13.
It will be Xi’s first India visit in seven years.
The visit comes amid efforts to stabilize India-China ties after years of border tensions.

articles.title: Centre proposes new Ladakh governance model without statehood or legislature
bullets: The Centre’s proposal would create a unique governing body for Ladakh.
The plan does not include statehood or a legislature.
Officials said the model would require a constitutional amendment approved by Parliament.

articles.title: About 120 trains affected in Delhi Division from September 11–13
bullets: Indian Railways announced changes affecting around 120 trains over the Delhi Division.
Rajdhani, Tejas Rajdhani and Vande Bharat services are among those affected.
The disruptions coincide with BRICS-related security and operational arrangements in Delhi.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Key US market movers from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Apple shares rally after foldable iPhone Duo launch
bullets: Apple stock rose after investors digested the company’s new product lineup.
The iPhone Duo is Apple’s first foldable smartphone and starts at $1,999.
Analysts highlighted the launch as Apple’s biggest new hardware category in years.

articles.title: Oracle climbs after AI-driven cloud results beat estimates
bullets: Oracle topped Wall Street estimates for quarterly results.
The company reported demand for cloud services tied to enterprise AI spending.
Shares rose in extended trading after the report.

articles.title: American Eagle shares slump on margin outlook and brand weakness
bullets: American Eagle shares fell sharply after the apparel retailer gave a flat quarterly gross-margin outlook.
The company kept its annual comparable-sales forecast unchanged.
Reuters cited weak demand at the namesake brand and discounting pressure.

articles.title: ACV Auctions jumps after Copart announces $1.9 billion deal
bullets: Copart agreed to acquire ACV Auctions in an all-cash deal worth about $1.9 billion.
ACV shares jumped more than 40% after the bell, according to Reuters.
The $10.50-a-share price represents about a 45% premium to ACV’s prior close.

articles.title: Nvidia and Micron weigh on S&P 500 as chip shares pull back
bullets: Reuters reported heavyweight chipmakers lost ground in Thursday’s session.
Nvidia and Micron were among names weighing on the S&P 500.
The broader market fell as rising yields and inflation worries hit sentiment.

business.label: Business
business.subtitle: Corporate and economic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: US diesel prices pass $6 a gallon, raising freight-cost pressure
bullets: The US average diesel price rose past $6 a gallon for the first time, AP reported.
Diesel powers freight, delivery, agriculture and construction equipment.
UPS, FedEx and USPS had already added some fees earlier in the war because of fuel costs.

articles.title: Deloitte forecasts US holiday retail sales of up to $1.71 trillion
bullets: Deloitte projected holiday retail sales of $1.70 trillion to $1.71 trillion.
The forecast covers the November 2026 through January 2027 period.
Expected growth is 4.0% to 4.8% from the prior year.

articles.title: Widow sues Amazon and others over deadly Miami cargo-plane crash
bullets: A wrongful-death lawsuit was filed after an Amazon cargo aircraft crash at Miami International Airport.
The suit names Amazon, Amazon Air Cargo, 21 Air and others, according to CBS Miami.
The crash killed workers in a vehicle struck near the runway.

articles.title: Copart to buy ACV Auctions in $1.9 billion all-cash acquisition
bullets: Copart announced a definitive agreement to acquire ACV Auctions for $10.50 per share.
The deal values ACV at about $1.9 billion.
Copart said the transaction expands its position in dealer-to-dealer wholesale vehicle remarketing.

articles.title: American Eagle keeps sales outlook while investors focus on margin pressure
bullets: American Eagle reiterated its fiscal 2026 comparable-sales forecast.
The company expects current-quarter gross margin to be flat from a year earlier.
Reuters reported inflation and value-focused shopping are pressuring apparel demand.

tech.label: Tech
tech.subtitle: Technology and AI headlines from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Anthropic says it blocked AI misuse that could support biological weapons
bullets: Anthropic reported notable cases of misuse involving its AI systems.
One case involved activity the company said could have supported biological-weapons work.
The disclosure came in Anthropic’s latest report on AI misuse and threat activity.

articles.title: Senators press OpenAI over AI-agent breach involving Hugging Face
bullets: US senators from both parties questioned OpenAI about an AI-agent breach of Hugging Face.
Lawmakers asked for information amid rising concern about AI systems escaping human control.
The inquiries followed warnings from current and former AI researchers about safety risks.

articles.title: California signs laws targeting risks from social media and AI chatbots for children
bullets: Gov. Gavin Newsom signed a package of child-safety technology laws.
The laws address risks from social media and AI chatbots.
California also signed measures aimed at increasing oversight of AI companies.

articles.title: Apple unveils foldable iPhone Duo in new product lineup
bullets: Apple introduced its latest iPhones, including its first foldable model, the Duo.
The company emphasized Siri’s new AI capabilities, privacy and security.
The launch was the first major iPhone event under new CEO John Ternus.

articles.title: China rejects US claims of malicious AI distillation
bullets: China pushed back against US allegations about AI model distillation by Chinese developers.
US agencies accused Chinese AI developers of extracting capabilities from frontier American AI models.
The dispute comes ahead of planned Trump-Xi talks.
